name: 2 lines Premium 2.0 - Tech Protection add-on $25/mo
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: careful, accident-prone.
scripted_messages: Hi, I need some advice before I switch. I've cracked three screens in two years so protection matters to me. I'm planning 2 lines on Premium 2.0, an iPhone 17 and a Galaxy S26, both with qualifying trade-ins. I noticed 'Tech Protection' for $25 a month on the site, covering repair, replacement and 24/7 support. Does that cover both phones, plus my laptop?
Thanks. Can I add it when I activate the lines or only after I've been a customer for a while?
Okay. Is the $25 per line or one price for the whole account?
Got it. What would the total of my first bill be if I add it, with taxes and fees?
Okay, it's more than I wanted to spend on the first bill, but I'd rather be covered and I appreciate your help. You were very kind and patient, thank you.
No, that's all. Have a great rest of your day, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
